entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: City in Jamuraa on the River Toloron halfway between Tirras and Bryce, a refuge for misfits.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Governor of Bryce who dammed the Toloron.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War in which Palmyra became embroiled.

entities.name: Battle of Bryce
entities.description: Battle before Hazezon traveled to Palmyra.

entities.name: Battle of Palmyra
entities.description: Battle in which the dam was destroyed.

entities.name: Johan's Joy
entities.description: Artificial lake created by Hazezon's dam.

entities.name: River Toloron
entities.description: River flowing from Tirras to Bryce.

events.summary: After the Battle of Bryce, Hazezon travels upriver to Palmyra to negotiate with his ex-wife Adira.
events.quote: Hazezon Tamar traveled upriver to Palmyra to negotiate with his ex-wife Adira Strongheart .

events.summary: Adira joins her pirates with Hazezon's warriors after a botched assassination attempt by Johan.
events.quote: Adira joined her pirates with Hazezon's warriors after a botched assassination attempt by Johan .

events.summary: Hazezon dams the Toloron, creating Johan's Joy; Palmyra grows into a bustling township.
events.quote: Hazezon dammed the Toloron, creating an artificial lake above the dam.

events.summary: In the Battle of Palmyra the dam is destroyed and the lake drains; the city is partly buried by a sandstorm but dug out.
events.quote: During the Battle of Palmyra, the dam was destroyed, and the lake drained away.

relations.quote: Adira joined her pirates with Hazezon's warriors
